title: Ideal $n$-cotorsion pairs in Frobenius extriangulated categories
summary: Motivated by the correspondence between ideal cotorsion pairs in Frobenius exact categories and those in their stable categories, we introduce the notion of an ideal $n$-cotorsion pair in an extriangulated category. We study the relationship between ideal $n$-cotorsion pairs in a Frobenius extriangulated category $\mathcal C$ and those in its stable category $\underline{\mathcal C}=\mathcal C/ω$.
